name: Example: Identifying Dimensions of Blocks in Partitioned Matrices
problem:
A partitioned matrix $M$ contains the following blocks: 

- $M_{11},$ which is a $1 \times 2$ block

- $M_{12},$ which is a $1 \times 3$ block

- $M_{21},$ which is a $2 \times 2$ block

Find the dimensions of the block $M_{22}$.
worked_solution:
We have a matrix of the form
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14041065/assets/2ebec2a87fd922bcbe30ee648e102188b48854abcad34d88cc18695cac67e1bd.png)

Therefore,  $M_{22}$ must be a $2 \times 3$ block.
